New Regulations for Trekking and Camping in Bhadarwah, Jammu-Kashmir

The Indian government has announced new regulations requiring permits for trekking and camping in the Bhadarwah area of Jammu-Kashmir. This move aims to protect the region's natural resources and ensure public safety. The decision has sparked debate among outdoor enthusiasts and local residents, who are concerned about the impact on tourism and livelihoods.
